query: SELECT id AS "id!", (COALESCE(last_attempt_at, created_at) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(last_attempt_at, created_at) >= $3::text::timestamptz) AS "is_fresh!" FROM twitch_clips_upload_queue WHERE clip_id = $1 AND platform = $2 AND status = 'processing' ORDER BY COALESCE(last_attempt_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
